messages:
jess: Kicking off v3.0.0 regional rollout (US -> EU -> APAC). Change window 01:00-02:30 UTC. Leads: @raj US, @nina EU, @paul APAC. Need quick warm/capacity checks + smoke owners. Callout: watch long-context perf.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-west slice-2 (version v3.0.0). Initial traffic 5%. Ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% per 12m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/1789991111. /deploy status: canary=us:5% health=ok.

raj: US warm pool 1.8x after prewarm. p95 ~85ms, QPS +12% vs baseline. GPU mem headroom ok. smoke/us/v3.0.0 all green. :white_check_mark:

nina: EU warmers stuck in fra-1 due to another job; warm pool 0.65x. p95 jumped to 160ms in that AZ. Recommend pin EU to v2.9.8 until FRA-1 cleared or we bump burst-reserve.

jess: Agreed. Pin EU to v2.9.8 and set eu traffic for v3.0.0 -> 0. No partial routes.

deploy-bot: Action: pinned region eu -> v2.9.8 (user jess). Recorded commands: `rbctl pin --region eu --ver v2.9.8` `deploy canary --region us`. Canary in US continues.

paul: APAC check: tokyo pool 1.2x good, sydney pool 0.9x (lagging warmers). I'll trigger `prewarm --burst` for syd and delay start by ~20m. ETA ~20m.

raj: Observed slight long-context latency spike when ramp hit 20% (specific to >4k token traces). error-rate ~0.15% atm, but alignment evals flagged drift on long prompts. Holding further ramp at 25%.

evals-bot: alignment-regression alert: A/B reranker score -3 pts on long-context testset (non-critical but notable). Link: https://evals.redwood/1789991111.

ops-oncall: Rollback criteria recap: sustained errors >0.5% for 5m OR p95 >200ms OR failing critical alignment set. If triggered: immediate rollback of region -> previous version, page SRE, open incident stub. Keep deadman timers.

jess: Hold US ramp at 25%. EU remains pinned. APAC delayed. Update release notes to call out long-context perf risk and EU pin.

nina: FRA-1 warmers cleared (manual bump burst-reserve). EU warm pool now 1.05x. Kicking off `smoke/eu/v3.0.0` (chat + reranker microtests).

deploy-bot: smoke/eu/v3.0.0: PASS except reranker microtest flake 0.2% (within threshold). Recommendation: unpin eu and start canary at 10%. Full log: https://ci.redwood/smoke/1789991111.

jess: Unpin EU and start eu canary at 10%. Keep a close eye on long-context eval dashboards.

deploy-bot: Unpinned region eu (user jess). Canary started eu:10% (version v3.0.0). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/1789991111/eu.

paul: APAC ready. Starting tokyo-only canary at 5% (syd still warming).

deploy-bot: APAC canary started tokyo:5% (v3.0.0). Ramp schedule noted.

ops-oncall: Reminder: do NOT mute alerts. Set 10m deadman timers for each region. Keep traffic-slice docs open and have rollback commands copied.

jess: Thanks team. I'll merge the release notes and publish changelog with EU pin explanation + long-context caveat. Keep this thread live for any rollback/heat signals. :pray:
